leila: quick heads-up — onboarding IvyBridge invoice-parser LoRA blend into redwood-13b-int4. Did a merge + quant smoke. Observed consistent under-estimation of invoice amounts (e.g., $1200 -> $120). Repro below, need help triaging before we sign off customer. Commands I ran:

leila: ```
REPRO_CMD="rwi eval --model redwood-13b --adapter ivybridge-lora --quant int4 --dataset invoices-mini.json --metrics amount_mae,exact_match --seed 42"
evalpack run $REPRO_CMD
```

sam: can you paste an example input + expected vs actual?

leila: example:
leila: ```
INPUT: "Total due: $1,245.67 on 2025-11-03"
EXPECTED: "1245.67"
ACTUAL (int4): "124.5"  <-- missing digit
```

omar: is this only on hosted API or also on dedicated/private?

leila: both on local smoke and hosted shadow-run. Float32 baseline is fine. Int4 spike only when kv-fusion is enabled.

cheng: quick idea — try disabling kv-fuse and see if quant kernel fallback helps. e.g. `--no-kv-fuse` and also try `--quant-backend=tvm` if available.

maria: can you paste the quickpack results? even 20 examples is fine.

buildbot: CI-smoke (repro) finished: float32 amount_mae=0.98, int4 amount_mae=4.92, int4 + --no-kv-fuse amount_mae=1.05

sam: I'll repro on dedicated GPU (prod-reserved) and check kv-cache alignment. @leila any logs/stack traces?

leila: logs: "tokenizer alignment shift at step 0 when kv-fuse true" — posting snippet:
leila: ```
[2026-03-22 18:00:12] INFO tokenizer: mapped token ids differ len=5 -> 4
[2026-03-22 18:00:12] WARN kv: fused qkv kernel produced mismatch for key idx 0
```

cheng: sounds like packing/truncation bug in the fused qkv path for certain tokenizers. Could be tokenizer->backend byte alignment. Try running with `--pad-longer-prefix`.

maria: created small evalpack: invoices-amounts-20.jsonl, added to ticket IN-1234.

leila: plan: 1) sam to run dedicated repro + raw logits 2) cheng to run alternate quant backend & kv-fuse off 3) I'll produce customer-facing summary and rollback suggestion (use float32 or int4+no-kv-fuse). Thanks 🙏

sam: on it, ping me if you need logs collected differently.

leila: adding this thread to onboarding ticket IN-1234 and to the evalpack repo. cc: @maria @cheng :thumbsup:
